messages:
lee (AE): Hey team — procurement asked for a concise BCP/DR statement for the SIG: RTO/RPO numbers, backup cadence, and evidence of failover testing. Need a 2-sentence summary + 3 FAQs we can hand them.

nina (security-eng): I can write the summary. We'll include concrete operational targets for hosted, and a note that Dedicated/Private runbooks are customer-specific. I can attach a redacted drill report.

omar (prod-eng): For hosted API we operate a multi-region setup. SLA is 99.9%. Operational targets: control-plane failover RTO <= 15 minutes under normal conditions, RPO near-zero for active requests thanks to continuous KV/prefix replication and incremental metadata snapshots. Backups: metadata every 5 minutes; encrypted snapshots nightly; default retention 90 days (contract adjustable). We run quarterly tabletop reviews and semi-annual live failover drills.

kai (solutions): Good. Keep the paragraph plain language and add an FAQ: how we get those numbers, what artifacts we can share, and how tests can be scheduled.

nina (security-eng): Draft paragraph: "Redwood Inference runs a redundant, multi-region serving platform. For our hosted API we target a control-plane failover RTO of <=15 minutes and a near-zero RPO for in-flight requests due to continuous KV/prefix replication and incremental metadata checkpoints; critical metadata is backed up every 5 minutes with encrypted snapshots retained per contract. We perform quarterly tabletop exercises and periodic live failover drills; a redacted test summary is attached for vendor review."

lee (AE): Nice. Artifact-bot, can you upload the redacted summary?

artifact-bot: Sanitized failover report uploaded: sales-artifacts/sanitized-failover-2026-02-03.pdf (access: sales, security).

kai (solutions): FAQ bullets (short): 1) "How do you achieve low RTO/RPO?" — Automated routing, cross-region replication, continuous KV/prefix replication, and incremental checkpoints allow rapid failover and cache warmup. 2) "What backups exist?" — Config/metadata backups every 5 minutes, encrypted nightly snapshots, default 90-day retention (customizable). 3) "Can we validate with a test?" — Yes; we support scheduled canary failovers for POCs and will provide a sanitized run report; full logs or runbooks require NDA and security redaction.

omar (prod-eng): Note for sales: Dedicated/Private deployments often have different RTO/RPO profiles depending on customer topology (on-prem networking, custom backups). Offer to produce architecture-specific targets during onboarding.

lee (AE): Sending this to the buyer now with the PDF link. Will flag if they ask for deeper artifacts. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
